owner_intent: Treat 'a fully alive game' as an end-to-end production requirement owned by the project. The owner must not have to remember or request each micro-detail.
truth_boundary: This is a coverage/control map. READY/ACCEPTED is never inferred from planning, source discovery or generated external media. Each layer advances only from evidence matching its state.

control_state.rule: Do not move the integration head while the self-hosted runner is offline/queued. Continue only isolated offline-safe generation, sourcing, provenance, manifests and production preparation.

evidence_states.PLANNED: Requirement/slot exists but no production asset evidence.
evidence_states.CANDIDATE: A source candidate exists; not staged/import-ready.
evidence_states.AUTHORIZED_FOR_STAGING: Source page/license/direct acquisition path recorded; content still requires intake QA.
evidence_states.GENERATED_EXTERNAL: Generated source media exists outside UE and is registered.
evidence_states.WAV_MASTER_PENDING: Source exists but clean production WAV master is not durably staged.
evidence_states.READY_FOR_IMPORT: Durable production master + provenance + integrity/technical QC exist.
evidence_states.UE_IMPORTED: UE asset exists at the contracted path; playback not implied.
evidence_states.RUNTIME_WIRED: Runtime route/binding exists; real playback still needs evidence.
evidence_states.TEST_PENDING: Implementation/assets exist but PIE/device/human acceptance is missing.
evidence_states.N_A: Layer is explicitly not applicable to the chapter/state.

completion_rule: A chapter is not experientially complete while any applicable life layer is silently absent. Every required slot must be ACCEPTED or explicitly N_A; partial technical import never counts as bank completion.

priority_order: Already-staged/authorized project warehouse sources with clear provenance and appropriate quality
CC0/public-domain or clearly licensed professional libraries
Per-item licensed sources with exact license/provenance capture
Original generation/recording for uncovered or identity-specific needs
Reference-only film/game material never becomes production media without separate rights
live_license_research_2026_09_24: Sonniss GDC bundle current v2.0 allows royalty-free synchronized game/media use and modification, but raw/re-designed SFX redistribution is restricted; preserve acquisition-date licence version.
Freesound is per-sound CC0/CC-BY/CC-BY-NC; production lane prefers CC0 and records exact item license.
Pixabay current Content License allows free use/modification without required attribution, subject to prohibited uses including standalone redistribution.
BBC Sound Effects archive is personal/educational/research by default; production requires separate commercial licensing.
Quaternius current site uses QAL v1.0, not blanket CC0; commercial project use is allowed but raw-asset redistribution is prohibited.
Poly Haven and ambientCG remain CC0 sources for environment materials; Kenney asset pages are CC0.

import_policy.rule: Technical imports may be executed in controlled sub-batches, but P1C01 audio is not called integrated/complete until every applicable bank slot has a durable master, UE asset at the contracted path, runtime binding and required playback evidence.
source_asset_rules: Preserve cue/asset IDs and provenance across conversion/import.
WAV master is preferred before UE import; generated MP3 is an intake source, not the production master.
Use soft references and async FStreamableManager for heavy/nonresident audio.
Localized emitters use 3D attenuation and bounded concurrency; long ambience/music remain managed persistent layers.
Do not bulk-load the raw warehouse into memory.

performance_guardrails: Target: i7 6th gen, 8GB RAM, about 2GB VRAM, DX11, 720p Low-Medium, 30 FPS floor.
NPC crowds use pooling; no high-frequency Spawn/Destroy churn.
Repeated visual detail uses ISM/HISM and culling.
Simulation/animation/audio fidelity scales by distance, relevance and visibility.
Bound simultaneous voices, fauna, foley and spot ambience; story-critical cues have priority.
Do not invent final numeric budgets before target-device measurement.
